entries.title: Press ⌘L to get back to your message
entries.body: From anywhere in the window, even inside a card, a card's reply or the Tasks panel, ⌘L puts you back in the main message box. Your words and the cursor stay where you left them. From Settings it takes you home first.
entries.noPicture: A key moves the cursor: a still picture of the message box after ⌘L looks the same as after a click.
